Create a sale order. The optional uuid field is tenant-global among active sale orders. The authenticated integration source gates replay: a same-source replay returns the active existing order, while an active UUID owned by another or missing source returns the existing sale-order collision error. Omitting uuid preserves normal creation behavior. After an order is soft-deleted, its UUID may be reused.

default.description: Error envelope. In particular, an active UUID owned by another integration source (or with no source ownership) returns the existing sale-order AlreadyExists collision error instead of exposing or reusing that order.

uuid.description: Optional external idempotency key. UUID uniqueness is tenant-global among active sale orders. The authenticated integration source gates replay: if it owns the active UUID, the existing order is returned; an active UUID owned by another or missing source returns the sale-order AlreadyExists collision. Source ownership is never accepted from the request body. After an order is soft-deleted, its UUID may be reused.

section_ids.description: Sections (departments) this position belongs to (required, at least one). Every id must reference an existing, non-deleted section.
